title: The Biscuit Tin  (A Lata de Biscoitos)

segments.t: O sol da manhã entra pelas venezianas verdes abertas do Quarto 9. {Hannah} estende um pano de prato limpo sobre uma pequena mesa enquanto {Tessa} e {Arthur} se debruçam sobre o pacote de tecido encerado. Ouça toda a cena primeiro.
Untie the string slowly, {Hannah}—thirty-year-old twine could snap in a second!
Beeswax on heavy linen really works; not one drop of dampness reached the inside.
Fold back the left flap, fold back the right flap... look at those bright colours!
Wait—I know that red-and-gold tin box! My aunt kept holiday almond biscuits in it!
Look at the strip of white cloth tape wrapped around the rim of the lid.
There are words written in faded black ink right across the top of the tin!
Pull down my glasses—no, here they are—let me read my family handwriting!
What does the label on the lid say, {Arthur}?
It says: Time Capsule of Room Eight and Room Nine, May, for a sunny morning.
They really left this box waiting for the week Room Nine opened again!
Try lifting the corner of the lid, {Hannah}—will it open by hand?
Not a millimetre; thirty years made this tin lid tight, so call {Graham}!
Agora vamos repassar a conversa com calma, frase por frase.
Untie the string slowly, {Hannah}—thirty-year-old twine could snap in a second!
'Desamarre o barbante lentamente, Hannah — um barbante de trinta anos pode arrebentar em um segundo!'
Beeswax on heavy linen really works; not one drop of dampness reached the inside.
'Cera de abelha em linho grosso realmente funciona; nem uma gota de umidade alcançou o interior.'
Fold back the left flap, fold back the right flap... look at those bright colours!
'Dobre para trás a aba esquerda, dobre para trás a aba direita... olhem para essas cores vivas!'
Wait—I know that red-and-gold tin box! My aunt kept holiday almond biscuits in it!
'Espere — eu conheço essa caixa de lata vermelha e dourada! Minha tia guardava biscoitos de amêndoa dos feriados nela!'
Look at the strip of white cloth tape wrapped around the rim of the lid.
'Olhe para a tira de fita de pano branco enrolada ao redor da borda da tampa.'
There are words written in faded black ink right across the top of the tin!
'Existem palavras escritas com tinta preta desbotada bem no topo da lata!'
Pull down my glasses—no, here they are—let me read my family handwriting!
'Abaixe meus óculos — não, aqui estão eles — deixe-me ler a caligrafia da minha família!'
What does the label on the lid say, {Arthur}?
'O que diz o rótulo na tampa, Arthur?'
It says: Time Capsule of Room Eight and Room Nine, May, for a sunny morning.
'Diz: Cápsula do Tempo do Quarto Oito e Quarto Nove, maio, para uma manhã ensolarada.'
They really left this box waiting for the week Room Nine opened again!
'Eles realmente deixaram esta caixa esperando pela semana em que o Quarto Nove abrisse de novo!'
Try lifting the corner of the lid, {Hannah}—will it open by hand?
'Tente levantar o canto da tampa, Hannah — ela abre com a mão?'
Not a millimetre; thirty years made this tin lid tight, so call {Graham}!
'Nem um milímetro; trinta anos deixaram a tampa desta lata apertada, então chame Graham!'
Vamos ouvir toda a cena novamente em velocidade natural.
Untie the string slowly, {Hannah}—thirty-year-old twine could snap in a second!
Beeswax on heavy linen really works; not one drop of dampness reached the inside.
Fold back the left flap, fold back the right flap... look at those bright colours!
Wait—I know that red-and-gold tin box! My aunt kept holiday almond biscuits in it!
Look at the strip of white cloth tape wrapped around the rim of the lid.
There are words written in faded black ink right across the top of the tin!
Pull down my glasses—no, here they are—let me read my family handwriting!
What does the label on the lid say, {Arthur}?
It says: Time Capsule of Room Eight and Room Nine, May, for a sunny morning.
They really left this box waiting for the week Room Nine opened again!
Try lifting the corner of the lid, {Hannah}—will it open by hand?
Not a millimetre; thirty years made this tin lid tight, so call {Graham}!
Por baixo do linho encerado brilha uma lata de biscoitos de amêndoa vermelha e dourada esperando por Graham e suas mãos firmes. Até a próxima.
See you soon!
